entries.reason: H130 quantifies over every full Policy-0T execution and demands an ordinary Resolution refutation of size O(W). Policy-0T first runs a polynomial visible-affine/Gaussian dispatcher. On bounded-degree expander-Tseitin CNFs this branch decides UNSAT before recursive search, while classical Urquhart and Ben-Sasson-Wigderson lower bounds require exponential ordinary Resolution size. Therefore no O(W) ordinary-Resolution simulation exists for the full dispatcher.
salvage: H132 restricts ordinary Resolution simulation to affine_answer=None executions, exactly the branch used on the MAJ3-lifted target.
H133 assigns the full dispatcher to Res(⊕), emitting parity certificates for affine termination and clause proofs for the non-affine core.
H134 isolates the recursive decision-clause translation lemma and its finite proof-emitting implementation.
